findings.title: Critical security problem in UpdraftCentral: an attacker holding the service's keys planted a backdoor on our websites
findings.summary_md: Nethemba discovered the campaign on their own infrastructure and published the first technical analysis, including indicators of compromise and a read-only checking script. They reported the issue to TeamUpdraft after finding that attackers used valid UpdraftCentral connection keys to upload backdoor plugins to connected WordPress sites.

findings.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral Keys Are Backdooring WordPress Sites
findings.summary_md: Patchstack confirmed the campaign and extended the observed scope, noting the commands were correctly signed with genuine dashboard keys and that affected releases 1.26.11 and 2.26.11.26 were impacted. They advised deleting UpdraftCentral keys as the effective mitigation because no plugin update stopped the attack at publication.

findings.title: TeamUpdraft security incident: What customers need to know
findings.summary_md: TeamUpdraft disclosed unauthorized access to teamupdraft.com over the weekend of October 17-18, 2026, believing its customer database was accessed. That database contained connection keys for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone along with customer account information.
